chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Qarin (one who performs Hajj al-Qiran) is not [valid] except with the ushering of the sacrificial animal, and upon him are two circumambulations of the House and one Sa'ee between al-Safa and al-Marwa, just as the Mufrid does; he is not superior to the Mufrid except by the ushering of the sacrificial animal.

key_terms.السَّعْيُ: Sa'ee: The ritual walking between the hills of Safa and Marwa.
key_terms.الْقَارِنُ: The Qarin: A pilgrim who combines Umrah and Hajj together, entering ihram for both simultaneously.
key_terms.الْمُفْرِدُ: The Mufrid: A pilgrim who performs Hajj exclusively, separate from Umrah.
key_terms.بِسِيَاقِ الْهَدْيِ: With the ushering/accompanying of the sacrificial animal (hady), a required offering for Qarin and Mufrid.
key_terms.طَوَافَانِ: Two circumambulations (tawaf), referring to Tawaf al-Qudum (arrival) and Tawaf al-Ziyarah (visitation).

ai.seo_question: What are the obligations and rulings for a person performing Hajj al-Qiran according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of Hajj al-Qiran, establishing that the pilgrim performs the rites of Umrah and Hajj together without the extra Sa'i required by the Mufrid, relying instead on the sacrificial animal (hady) as the distinguishing factor. Scholarly tradition emphasizes that this equality in reward underscores the completeness of the combined pilgrimage, provided the hady is maintained until the sacrifice. This ruling highlights the practical flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the integration of Umrah and Hajj rituals.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, from Mansour Bin Hazim,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The performance of the pairing (Umra & Hajj) cannot happen except with ushering of the sacrificial animal, and upon him would be two circumambulations with the House (Kabah), and one Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, just as he would do performing the exclusive Hajj. It is not with the superiority than the exclusive (Hajj) except by the ushering of the sacrificial animal’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from af-Fadf ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hafs al- Bakhtariy from Mansur al-Hazim who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

al-Qiran Hajj does not happen without offering sacrifice and one must do two Tawaf and a Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah, just as it is done in al-Hajj in al-Ifrad (an individual) manner, and al-Qiran Hajj is not more virtuous than al-Mufrid (individual) Hajj except for herding the sacrificial animal.”
